# How much of what you earn should you set aside for tax?

> Free Canadian self-employed tax calculator: enter revenue and expenses to see CPP, federal tax, a provincial estimate and how much of every invoice to set aside. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/ca-self-employed-tax-set-aside-calculator/)
